subject: Charter Budget Requirements
overview: The Financial Procedures Subcommittee reviewed administrative feedback regarding charter requirements for a joint annual budget meeting and discussed research on city council budgetary powers. The subcommittee agreed to soften budget meeting requirements and propose that a future charter review study municipal budgeting practices in greater depth.

items.title: Article 6 Annual Budget Meeting Requirements
items.summary: Following feedback from the administration regarding conflicts with the existing budget ordinance, members agreed to recommend removing specific forecast requirements from Article 6 to keep the proposed joint budget meeting among the mayor, city council, and school committee more general and flexible.

items.title: Research on Legislative Budgetary Powers
items.summary: Jean Zotter presented research on municipal councils' authority to increase budget lines and on participatory budgeting practices, and the subcommittee decided to draft a recommendation that a future charter review committee reexamine these budgeting models rather than proposing an exception to state law now.
